thread:
maria: quick heads-up — PR #4321 landed an int8 quant path for llama-3-small-v2. Can someone sanity-check perf + quality before we bake it into the default profile?

ashok: I can run a quick benchmark. Which metrics do you want prioritized? p99 latency, throughput, mem, and the usual QA evals?

jules: yes p99/median, throughput (tokens/s) at batch=1/4/16, peak GPU mem, and delta on our qa_regression set (EM and avg logprob). Also check sample-level failures for hallucinations.

maria: exact: p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec at 1/4/16, GPU mem, and QA_EM_delta on qa_regression_v3. Gate is EM drop <= 0.5 points. If >0.5, we block rollout.

sam: quick note — FP8 experiments from last month were promising for latency but had a few outliers in multi-turn QA. Keep an eye on conversation continuity tests.

ashok: running now. command i'm using: 

```
./tools/bench --model=llama-3-small-v2 --quant=int8 --config=configs/bench-low-latency.yaml --batches=\"1,4,16\" --eval-set=data/qa_regression_v3.jsonl --out=artifacts/int8_run_171509
```

benchbot: job started: id=9876, runner=gs-rt-prod-04, queued 30s.

ashok: quick snapshot (first 10k tokens run):
```
p50=18ms p95=42ms p99=78ms
tokens/sec (b1)=210 tps (b4)=640 tps (b16)=2200
gpu_mem_peak=6.8GB
qa_em_delta=-0.6
```

jules: -0.6 EM is slightly over the 0.5 gate. Can you dump the failed examples and a few rolling traces? Want to see if it's systematic or a handful of edge cases.

ashok: attaching top failures in artifacts/int8_run_171509/fails_top20.jsonl and a trace for one fail (prefix+kvcache) in artifacts/int8_trace_123.log — looks like answer truncation in multi-turn contexts.

maria: interesting — how does fp8 compare on the same run? any chance we can try int4 also? I want the trade space: int8 vs int4 vs fp8.

ashok: kicking off int4 and fp8 now. int4 will need a different kernel path, so throughput may improve but risk is higher.

benchbot: job 9877 (int4) queued, job 9878 (fp8) queued. Estimated runtime ~45m each.

sam: suggestion: run a focused eval: conversation-continuity set (200 multi-turn chats) + qa_regression. If int8 fails are truncation-related we should measure turn-consistency metrics (answer length retention, continuity-F1).

eva: also add perplexity and token-level avg logprob; sometimes EM hides subtle deterioration. We should compute avg_logprob_delta and PPL_delta. Gate them at tiny thresholds (e.g., avg_logprob_delta >= -0.03).

jules: good call. Also profile kernel launches and NV TX for int4 path; I want to see if there's more tiny context-switch overhead causing state corruption. ashok can you run nvprof / nsight for the failing example?

ashok: yes running nsight on the failing trace now, will attach flamegraphs.

benchbot: job 9878 (fp8) completed. summary: p50=16ms p95=40ms p99=72ms tokens/s b1=230 b4=700 b16=2400 gpu_mem=7.1GB qa_em_delta=-0.15 avg_logprob_delta=-0.008

maria: fp8 looks within gate and better than int8 on QA. Any stability issues observed?

benchbot: no instability flagged for fp8; 0 fails on qa_regression_v3 sample set.

ashok: int4 initial snapshot: p50=13ms p95=36ms p99=90ms tokens/s b1=270 b4=820 b16=2600 gpu_mem=5.6GB qa_em_delta=-1.8 avg_logprob_delta=-0.12 (many truncation and hallucination cases)

jules: wow int4 is risky. Big quality regression. Not a candidate for default. Can we try hybrid: fp8 for attention + int4 for FF layers, or per-layer mixed quant?

maria: yes propose two experiments: 1) fp8-default for now, 2) hybrid fp8-attn + int4-ff with calibration. Create tickets for both and run per-layer sensitivity. I'll open the rollout ticket for fp8 canary.

sam: for rollout: canary at 5-10% traffic, monitor qa_regression EM and avg_logprob in real time, auto-revert if EM drops >0.6 or avg_logprob_delta < -0.05 for any 10k request window.

eva: also add logging for top-k divergent responses and a lightweight classifier to detect hallucination score > threshold.

maria: assigned: ashok -> run full-run int8/int4/fp8 with complete evals + traces (due EOD). jules -> run nsight profile on 3 failing traces and look for kernel/state anomalies (due EOD). sam -> prepare canary rollout plan + metrics config for console (due tomorrow). eva -> add avg_logprob and continuity metrics to qa_regression harness and CI gating (PR welcome).

ashok: on it. started full int8/int4/fp8 runs and a long eval job (job ids 9880/9881/9882). will post links when finished.

benchbot: job 9880(int8) completed: full summary attached -> artifacts/int8_full_171509/summary.json; QA_EM_delta=-0.62, avg_logprob_delta=-0.025, top_fail_count=32.

maria: thanks. let's hold default change until we have hybrid tests. For now mark fp8 as "approved-for-canary". :white_check_mark:

ashok: noted. I'll comment on PR #4321 to change default quant profile to fp8 and add a follow-up ticket for hybrid experiments. pinging @jules for review on the PR.

jules: reviewing now. quick glance - need a unit test for quant profile selection and a small eval threshold test.

maria: thanks all — keep updates in this thread and paste the artifacts links. If anyone finds major regressions, flag incidents/priority channel.

benchbot: artifacts uploaded: gs://redwood-artifacts/int8_full_171509/ , gs://redwood-artifacts/int4_full_171509/ , gs://redwood-artifacts/fp8_full_171509/

ashok: final note — int4 might be salvageable with per-layer calibration and extra bias correction. I'll start a sensitivity sweep.

sam: awesome. if we converge, we can add a model variant profile (llama-3-small-v2.int4-calib) rather than replacing default.

maria: agreement — variant approach is safer. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
